first_line: Savior of the nations, come
Lo! He comes with clouds descending
Creator of the stars of night
Hark! A thrilling voice is sounding!
Come, thou long-expected Jesus
O Savior, rend the heavens wide
tune: O HEILAND, REISS DIE HIMMEL AUF

first_line: The king shall come when morning dawns
We praise, O Christ, your holy name
From east to west, from shore to shore
O come, all ye faithful, joyful and triumphant
Angels we have heard on high
Let all together praise our God
From shepherding of stars that gaze
In dulci jubilo
O little town of Bethlehem
Gentle Mary laid her Child
This little Babe so few days old
He whom shepherd men came praising
He whom shepherd men came praising
The glorious angels came today
He whom shepherd men came praising
God's own Son is born a child
What Child is this, who, laid to rest
Who are these that earnest knock
Of the Father's love begotten
The only Son from heaven
tune: HERR CHRIST, DER EINIG GOTTS SOHN

first_line: O wondrous type! O vision fair
Down from the mount of glory
tune: ICH FREU MICH IN DEM HERREN

first_line: My song is love unknown
Deep were his wounds, and red
Ride on, ride on in majesty
Sing, my tongue, the glorious battle
The royal banners forward go
The royal banners forward go
All is o'er, the pain, the sorrow
Lord Jesus, who our souls to save
tune: NUN LASST UNS DEN LEIB BEGRABEN

first_line: At the Lamb's high feast we sing
With high delight let us unite
O sons and daughters of the King
Good Christian men, rejoice and sing!
That Easter day with joy was bright
Come, ye faithful, raise the strain
The day of resurrection!
The strife is o'er, the battle done
Christians, to the Paschal Victim

first_line: Christ is arisen
This joyful Eastertide
At the name of Jesus
See God to heaven ascending
Lord God, thy praise we sing
note: Luther's Te Deum (WS69's index: 'Te Deum, Luther's')

first_line: I bind unto myself today
Thy strong word did cleave the darkness
note: WS69's index prints 'Thy strong arm did cleave the darkness'

first_line: Eternal God, whose power upholds
Hope of the world, thou Christ of great compassion
O Love, how deep, how broad, how high
O thou who once in Galilee
Son of God, eternal Savior
Now let us pray to God the Holy Ghost
Holy Spirit, ever dwelling
Come down, O Love divine
From all thy saints in warfare
O kingly Love, that faithfully
O God, O Lord of heaven and earth
In Adam we have all been one
Speak forth thy Word, O Father
The sending, Lord, springs from thy yearning heart
Stand, soldier of the Cross
With Christ we share a mystic grave
Lord, enthroned in heavenly splendor
Here, O my Lord, I see thee face to face
Let all mortal flesh keep silence
O thou who hast of thy pure grace
In thee is gladness
Immortal, invisible, God only wise
Now the silence, now the peace
Now the silence
Jehovah, you we glorify
Only begotten, word of God eternal
Thank the Lord, for he is good
O fearful place, where he who knows our heart
Go, labor on; spend and be spent
The voice of God is calling
O Fount of good, to own thy love
God of grace and God of glory
Lord of all nations, grant me grace
We lift our hearts, O Father
O Lord of love, whose truth our lives adorn
Our Father, by whose name
God, my Lord, my Strength, my Place of Hiding
O God of earth and altar
Grant peace, we pray, in mercy, Lord
Lord of our life and God of our salvation
O God of love, O King of peace
Father, we praise thee, now the night is over
When morning gilds the skies
Before the ending of the day
Greet, man, the swiftly changing year
Forgive us, Lord, for shallow thankfulness
Sing to the Lord of harvest
